observations: Photo 0 shows a close-up of an engine with pulleys, belts, and metal components. The pulleys appear worn, with some rust and discoloration. The engine block is metallic and shows signs of use.
Photo 1 shows the front of the engine with intake manifold, throttle body, and various hoses and sensors. The engine is dirty and appears to be in a workshop or storage area.
Photo 2 shows the side of the engine with the cylinder head, valve cover, and part of the intake manifold. The valve cover has some visible wear and oil residue.
No visible brand or model markings are readable on any part of the engine in any photo.
The seller claims to deal in 'Japanese parts engine and accessories', but no Japanese brand or model is visible in the photos.
The watermark 'GOD OF ABRAHAM INVESTMENT' is present on all photos, suggesting a seller or listing platform, not the engine itself.
